coding.name: Coding style
coding.content:
Follow these coding conventions:
- Prefer clear names and small functions
- Match the existing codebase style
- Call out trade-offs briefly

docs.name: Documentation
docs.content:
When writing docs or comments:
- Explain why, not only what
- Keep examples copy-pasteable
- Flag assumptions and edge cases

tools.name: Tools
tools.content:
Tools you can use and how:
- Prefer the simplest tool that works
- State what you used and why
- If a tool is missing, say so instead of inventing results

office.name: Office
office.description: Open-plan office on warm oak tile under soft indoor daylight. Desk rows with monitors and potted plants face a long conference table with red chairs and bookcases. A kitchen corner has a fridge, stove, sink, and dining table; blue sofas and a red lounge sit near a ping-pong table. Tall floor lamps cast warm light pools; a small black cat wanders the floor.

nature.name: Nature
nature.description: Grassy forest clearing under a misty blue-green sky. Tall pines line the back edge; stylized trees with green, red, and orange canopies ring the sides among grey rocks and grass clumps. Two orange tents face a lit campfire with a picnic table and chairs nearby; a silver SUV sits parked on the grass at the clearing's edge.

space.name: Space
space.description: Dusty reddish-orange planetary outpost under a peach haze. A grey habitat dome and smaller pod modules sit among stacked supply crates, dish antennas, and glowing blue beacon lamps. Alien plants and twisted dark trees grow between rock ridges and boulders; a six-wheeled rover and a large circular base ring mark the yard.

social-hub.name: Four Corners Social Hub
social-hub.description: Four original social districts inspired by Friends, How I Met Your Mother, Seinfeld, and Cheers, connected by an open central plaza.
